title: Flat module pullback is exact and direct image preserves injectives
statement: Let $h:T\to Z$ be a flat morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-flat-morphism]. On the categories of Zariski sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the pullback $h^*:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Z)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_T)$ of [def-pc-module-pullback] is exact. The right adjoint $h_*$ carries every injective $\mathcal O_T$-module [def-sp-injective-resolutions] to an injective $\mathcal O_Z$-module.

source.place: Modules 02N4, lemma-pullback-flat, line 3191; Cohomology 02N5, lemma-pushforward-injective-flat, line 1821; tags verified in /tmp/stacks-project/tags/tags

proof.text: Let $\mathcal F\xrightarrow{a}\mathcal G\xrightarrow{b}\mathcal H$ be any exact complex of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules, and fix $t\in T$, with $z=h(t)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact] the complex $\mathcal F_z\xrightarrow{a_z}\mathcal G_z\xrightarrow{b_z}\mathcal H_z$ is exact. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-pullback], naturally in the module, the stalk complex of $h^*\mathcal F\to h^*\mathcal G\to h^*\mathcal H$ at $t$ identifies with $\mathcal F_z\otimes_{\mathcal O_{Z,z}}\mathcal O_{T,t}\xrightarrow{a_z\otimes1}\mathcal G_z\otimes_{\mathcal O_{Z,z}}\mathcal O_{T,t}\xrightarrow{b_z\otimes1}\mathcal H_z\otimes_{\mathcal O_{Z,z}}\mathcal O_{T,t}$. Naturality of the cited isomorphism is what identifies the two differentials with these tensor maps.

proof.text: Flatness of $h$ means that $\mathcal O_{T,t}$ is flat over $\mathcal O_{Z,z}$ for every $t$ [def-weil-flat-morphism]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-tensor-exact] to $R=\mathcal O_{Z,z}$, $M=\mathcal O_{T,t}$ and the exact stalk complex from step 1. The tensor complex in step 1 is exact. Thus the pulled-back complex is exact at every stalk; [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact] implies it is exact as a complex of $\mathcal O_T$-modules.

proof.text: The functor $h^*$ is additive: in its defining inverse-image-and-tensor construction [def-pc-module-pullback], inverse image carries the sectionwise sum of morphisms to the sum, and $(a+a\prime)\otimes1=(a\otimes1)+(a\prime\otimes1)$ on pure tensors and hence on the sheafification. It sends the zero module to zero by the same construction. Steps 1 and 2 apply also to the complexes at the two ends of any short exact sequence, so $h^*$ preserves short exact sequences and is exact. By [def-pc-module-pullback] it is left adjoint to the module direct image $h_*$. To prove that $h_*\mathcal I$ is injective whenever $\mathcal I$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions], for a monomorphism $M\hookrightarrow N$, exactness makes $h^*M\hookrightarrow h^*N$ a monomorphism; a map $M\to h_*\mathcal I$ corresponds under the adjunction to $h^*M\to\mathcal I$, extends to $h^*N\to\mathcal I$ by injectivity, and its adjoint $N\to h_*\mathcal I$ extends the original map by naturality.
